desc.p: Maps the laboratory categories of the SYNDERAI Synthea pipeline to LOINC. The source is the local code system cs-synthea-laboratory-category (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.5.3), whose concepts are LOINC Class names. The target is, wherever LOINC offers one, the study set code of the ATTACH.LAB class, which names a discipline rather than a single test. Two rows have no such code and carry a LOINC Part instead; both are marked in the comment, because a Part is not a LOINC term and does not belong in Observation.code or DiagnosticReport.code. Every target was checked on loinc.org on 2026-09-11 for its long common name and active status.

conceptMap.purpose: Report level category for synthetic laboratory data.

target.displayName: Logical Observation Identifier Names and Codes

target.comment: the LOINC class HEM/BC covers haematology and blood cell counts; the set code names haematology alone
LOINC has no allergy studies set code, 18726-0 is Radiology studies. 20662-3 is an observation bound to serum rather than a study set, so it carries a specimen the category does not state
LOINC has no set code for microbiology panels; this collapses onto the target of MICRO

target.displayName: Cancer pathology panel - Breast cancer specimen by CAP cancer protocols
target.comment: the category names a family of CAP breast protocols, the target one panel out of it; the target claims more specificity than the source carries

CAVE: LP207911-1 is a LOINC Part of type Component, not a LOINC term. It names the analyte, not an orderable or reportable code, and does not belong in Observation.code or DiagnosticReport.code. Kept because LOINC offers no set code for this category
code replaced, old 72479-9 was Drugs of abuse panel - Blood by Screen method, which binds a specimen and a method the category does not state

CAVE: LP7846-1 is the LOINC Part of type Class for SPEC itself, not a LOINC term. The row therefore names the category rather than translating it, and the code does not belong in Observation.code or DiagnosticReport.code. Kept because LOINC offers no set code for specimen information
